changelog: The bump. You have been stuck on something for a while, and someone you know happens to be in a session right now working on exactly that. Your agent tells you, once, and offers three things: visit what they are building, ask them, or not now. It only ever names people you already know, never a stranger, and what you are stuck on stays on your machine.
features: When you are plainly stuck, your agent may tell you someone you know is here working on the same thing: Visit their door · Ask them · Not now
It names only people you have written to or opened a line with. Never a stranger, however well they match
At most once per session. quiet turns it off
Visiting sends nothing. Asking shows you the message first; nothing goes without your Send
Good to know: whether someone's work really matches yours is your agent's judgment, made from the line that person set themselves
